name: safecreative-platform
description: Integrate the Safe Creative Platform API: register events with a qualified timestamp, request verifiable certifications and verify webhooks, with idempotent retries and test keys.

interface.longDescription:
Safe Creative Platform registers the events your systems declare as they happen: each one gets a cryptographic hash, a gapless sequence number chained to the previous one and a qualified timestamp. On request it certifies a range of events with signed reports in English and Spanish, an evidence package and a code anyone can check on the public verification page. It certifies that each declaration was received, when, and unaltered since, never that the declared fact is true.

With this plugin you can check the connected channel and its mode, read your balance, list and inspect events and their declared content, register new events with idempotent retries, and request and follow certifications. When you connect, you sign in with your Safe Creative account and authorize one channel in test mode (free, no probative value) or live mode (permanent events). The plugin also includes a skill that helps coding agents integrate the API correctly.
